ns2:course.label: Spanish/English Translation
ns2:course.description: Review of current translation theory and analysis and practice of the translation from Spanish to English (and vice versa) of a variety of text types, ranging from short literary texts to everyday commercial discourse such as that found on product labels. Emphasis on linguistic and cultural aspect of literary discourses as well as non-literary texts. Conducted in Spanish. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: SPAN 250 or SPAN 252 (or equivalent); credit or concurrent enrollment in CWL 471.
